thread:
izzy: quick q - I hit duplicated uploads in the sampleapp when our token rotated during a 429 surge. anyone seen this pattern? :confused:

noah: yep. often happens when retry window + token refresh overlap and SDK resumes the request without idempotency.

reina: curious: which jitter strategy were you using? full-jitter tends to spread retries more, might help.

izzy: running full-jitter but short backoff base (50ms). also no idempotency-key by default in the sample app.

noah: two small fixes: 1) generate Idempotency-Key for mutating endpoints by default (opt-in via config) 2) introduce safe_replay_window_ms (default 500) so resume only within that time.

reina: add streaming nuance: resumable streams can replay partial tokens. need per-chunk seq numbers and server-side dedupe on (idempotency-key, seq).

izzy: good call. I can add seq headers in the harness and a dedupe endpoint on server to count duplicates.

ops-bot: test-run: jitter-repro-2070001234 queued on staging. details: /staging/jitter/2070/ :gear:

noah: also make explicit Idempotency-Key win if user supplies header. SDK should never overwrite explicit header.

reina: for SDK parity, let's land flags in node, python, and go together. small PRs with identical defaults (auto_idempotency: false, safe_replay_window_ms: 500).

izzy: plan: update harness, run matrix for windows [200,500,2000] and three jitter modes. will share CSVs. thanks! :rocket:
thread_summary: short repro and mitigation plan for duplicates during token rotation + 429 bursts: add opt-in auto-idempotency, safe_replay_window_ms, streaming seq ids, and cross-SDK parity testing
